title: Toolchain Pin Record
body:
Overview

This record documents Toolchain Pin Record within the Software Environment and Reproducible Builds Database. Captures environments, toolchains, configuration, and build provenance. It gives the archive a reusable, checkable entry for one recurring task: the entry states what the task is, how it is done, and what result was measured or computed when the accompanying demo program ran. The record is written so a reader can follow it without any other document open, and so an AI can apply it to a new task of the same shape without guessing at missing steps. # Release Reproducibility Audit: hash the pinned inputs twice and compare the rebuild.
import hashlib
files = ['module-1.py', 'module-2.py', 'module-3.py', 'module-4.py']
contents = ['# source 0 seed 15 variant 1\nvalue = 1\n', '# source 1 seed 15 variant 1\nvalue = 19\n', '# source 2 seed 15 variant 1\nvalue = 37\n', '# source 3 seed 15 variant 1\nvalue = 55\n']
run1 = [hashlib.sha256(c.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] for c in contents]
run2 = [hashlib.sha256(c.encode()).hexdigest()[:12] for c in contents]
for f, a, b in zip(files, run1, run2):
    print(f, "run1", a, "run2", b, "match:", a == b)
print("files hashed:", len(files))
print("rebuild identical:", run1 == run2)
